summary: Learn essential camera operation skills for film and TV production. Enroll in our training course and take your filmmaking to the next level!
lede: Camera operation training prepares film and television crews to turn shot plans into consistent, technically usable footage. It is designed for camera operators, assistants and cinematographers who need to prepare camera setups, adapt to changing blocking and maintain visual continuity. Learners practise lens choice and framing, exposure monitoring, focus planning and controlled movement, then document scene coverage with camera reports and continuity checklists.
audienceIntro: Camera operator training suits professionals who need dependable camera craft for narrative, documentary, commercial, studio, and live production environments.
prerequisites: You do not need prior professional camera department experience, but basic camera handling is expected. Bring a notebook and, where available, a laptop for reviewing footage and organising production documents. TrainingCred can provide practice footage, camera reports, shot-list templates, continuity checklists, and exercise files. Camera models and accessories may vary by delivery location, so the instructor will explain equivalent controls across common digital cinema and broadcast systems.
